title: User Registration Form with Full Validation
description: Build a complete user registration form with comprehensive validation, inline errors, and success feedback - the kind you'd see in technical interviews.
requirements: Create a controlled form with 4 fields: username (text input), email (text input), password (password input), confirmPassword (password input)
Display a 'Register' submit button at the bottom

Implement validation rules:
   - username: required, min 3 characters, max 20 characters
   - email: required, must contain '@' and '.'
   - password: required, min 8 characters
   - confirmPassword: must match password exactly
Display inline error messages below each field when validation fails
Error messages should be styled in red and visible to the user
On successful validation, display success message 'Registration successful!' above the form
After successful submission, clear all fields and reset the form
Use proper semantic HTML with labels associated to inputs (htmlFor/id)
Each input should have placeholder text indicating what to enter

browserTests.name: Form renders with all required fields
Submitting empty form shows username error
Username too short shows length error
Password too short shows password error

hints.text: Start by setting up state for your form fields and errors. You'll need two objects: one for the form data (username, email, password, confirmPassword) and one for error messages.
Create a validate() function that checks each field and returns an errors object. For password confirmation, compare password === confirmPassword.

In handleSubmit: (1) prevent default, (2) call validate(), (3) if errors exist, setErrors and return, (4) if valid, show success message, clear form. Use a success state variable to control the success message display.
